name: Farmer Saldean
summary: At Saldean's Farm in central Westfall, Farmer Saldean keeps working the troubled fields beside his wife, Salma. While other farmers flee or give up, the veteran homesteader faces rogue harvest golems and growing banditry.

sections.title: Holding the Plow
sections.body: Farmer Saldean remembers when Westfall prospered, before those years crumbled away. Overgrown fields, rampaging mechanical harvest watchers, and predatory bandits now surround his farm, but he refuses to yield his land. Other homesteaders have abandoned their acres or turned to thievery. Saldean and his wife, Salma, stay and work to harvest what little grain they can. He asks wandering adventurers to destroy the rogue Harvest Watchers that have taken over his fields and his neighbors' fields, so he can clear the soil for planting.

sections.title: The Scythe of Westfall
sections.body: Between Sentinel Hill and the northern bridge, Saldean's defense of his homestead helps keep civilian life going. He remains tied to the People's Militia despite the hard times, and sends able-bodied travelers to Gryan Stoutmantle once his immediate troubles are settled. Clearing the wild harvest reapers can only give his farm a temporary reprieve. The lawlessness strangling the countryside still has to be dealt with.

faq.answer: Farmer Saldean is a veteran human farmer who lives at Saldean's Farm in Westfall with his wife, Salma. He is one of the few local homesteaders who refuses to abandon his soil despite famine, rogue harvest golems, and the region's growing banditry.

faq.q: Why is Farmer Saldean's farm in trouble?
faq.answer: Westfall's automated harvest golems have malfunctioned and gone wild, prowling cropland and attacking anyone in sight. Saldean needs adventurers to destroy the mechanical watchers in his fields and neighboring fields so he can reclaim his land.

faq.q: Where can Farmer Saldean be found?
faq.answer: Farmer Saldean can be found outside his farmhouse at Saldean's Farm, just off the main road in central Westfall and north of Sentinel Hill.

faq.q: Does Saldean support the People's Militia?
faq.answer: Yes. Saldean is busy defending his crops and home, but he directs capable adventurers down the road to Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill to help the People's Militia defend the region.

faq.q: What unique items does Saldean sell?
faq.answer: Saldean sells staple bread and is the primary purveyor of Special Chicken Feed, a curious grain sought by travelers hoping to befriend the local fowl wandering Westfall.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you see Saldean's stubborn resolve among Westfall's remaining loyalists, who cling to Kingdom soil even when the crown's soldiers are nowhere to be seen.
Farmers like Saldean are the crumbling backbone of Stormwind's food supply. Securing his crop keeps basic bread on tables across the kingdom.
